en.html:
Ichijou drew a sharp breath. One did not need military knowledge to read what this meant.

I nearly cursed. I did not. Instead I turned the <ruby>prow<rt>prow</rt></ruby> of my thinking toward something constructive. Everything depends on how one looks at it, they say.

An enemy warrior being changed was a big disadvantage, no doubt. But it was also the very chance to see where the human being sat inside the enemy unit, the one thing I had been wanting to know. Get hold of that, and <ruby>Shukyu<rt>the railgun</rt></ruby> could be used on the enemy unit.

How much power could come out of a heat reserve already scraping bottom, that was the question... But whatever, it was our only chance of winning.

I put my whole attention into my eyes.

　専門的な軍事知識を持ち合わせなくとも、その意味
は容易に知れたのだろう。

　だがそれは取り止めて、俺は思考の<ruby>舳先<rt>へさき</rt></ruby>を建設的な

達成できるかという問題はあるが……
　ともあれそこは唯一の勝機。

　俺は視覚に意識を集中させた。

en.html:
I stood up. Splendid. Hatred is power.

I could stand because I hated this much. I could move because I hated this much.

The burns in my leg gave out a savage pain.

...Not enough.

With every movement the armor I wore drank my life and called up an agony as if my organs were being wrung out.

...Not enough.

Not enough,

not enough,

not nearly enough.

More wounds were needed.

More curses were needed.

For him, more. More.

　　　　　　　　　　　Suffer.

One step, and my knee gave. It was rattling, laughing.

Pitiful. And you still have limbs that move.

　　　　　　　　　　　Suffer.

One step, and my eyes swam. Consciousness blurred; sensation went vague.

Pitiable. You can still see things. You can still hear sounds.

　　　　　　　　　　Murderer.

Think of the people who lost those.

Think.

Think of the people from whom you took them.

Think.

Ah.

　　　Kageaki Minato.

　　　May this agony torment you for all eternity,

　　　and never, ever let you go.

俺は立ち上がった。
　素晴らしい。憎悪こそは力だ。

　こんなにも憎いから立てる。
　こんなにも憎いから動ける。

　脚の火傷が猛痛を放った。
　……足りない。

　身動きする都度、よろう甲鉄が俺の命を吸い、内臓
を絞られるが如き苦痛を呼ぶ。
　……足りない。

　足りぬ、
　足りぬ、
　まるで足りぬ。

　もっと傷が必要だ。
　もっと呪いが必要だ。
　奴にはもっと。もっと。


　
　　　　　　　　　　　苦しめ。

　一歩進むと、膝が折れた。
　かくかくと笑っている。

　惨めがましい。
　まだお前には、動く手足があるくせに。


　
　　　　　　　　　　　苦しめ。

　一歩進むと、目が眩んだ。
　意識が霞み、感覚が曖昧になる。

　憐れがましい。
　お前はまだ、物を見て音を聞くことができるくせに。


　
　　　　　　　　　　ひとごろし。

　それを失くした人々のことを想え。
　想え。

　それをお前に奪われた人々のことを想え。
　想え。

　ああ。


　　　湊斗景明。
　　　どうかこの苦悶が未来永劫お前を苛み、
　　　決して解放せぬように。

en.html:
He was not burning for battle.

Battle was an assignment. A job. It had always been so. For him it was not some passionate act by which he questioned the meaning of his own existence; it was only a role handed to him.

The colleague who had been riding this Arahabaki until a short while ago was different. That one had the taste to savor a fight and enjoy it.

This taste he could not understand. What was there to enjoy in this? However solid the armor around him, being showered with bullets was a bone-chilling experience, and firing bullets into a target was not free of disgust either.

His comrade's battle with the crimson warrior he had watched to the end. That this was a rare and worthy enemy, he understood. But he was not a born warrior, and even that fact did not make him happy.

He wanted to go back quickly to <ruby>his wife and children<rt>them</rt></ruby>. On a battlefield, that was his only wish.

So when he finally found the enemy, what came over his chest was a wind in which the cold of fear mixed with the warmth of relief. His skin prickled even as his pulse settled.

...Ah.

The unpleasant business had finally begun.

...When this is over, I can go home...

At the edge of his <ruby>vision<rt>monitor</rt></ruby> he spotted a red <ruby>flicker<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>. He let out one sigh, and then got on with the work of moving the giant soldier.

彼は戦意に猛っていた――とは言えない。

　戦いは任務だ。仕事なのだ。常にそうだ。
　彼にとって、己の存在意義を問う情熱的行為などで
はなく、課せられた役割に過ぎない。

　先刻までこの荒覇吐を駆っていた彼の同僚は違った。
　戦いを楽しみ、味わう嗜好の持ち主だった。

　彼には理解し難い。こんなことの何が楽しいのか？
　どれほど堅牢な装甲に守られていても矢弾を浴びる
体験は怖気をふるうものだし、逆に標的へ銃弾を打ち
込む行為も嫌悪感と無縁では有り得ない。

　僚友が深紅色の武者と繰り広げた戦闘を彼は見届け
ている。滅多にない好敵と諒解もしている。
　だがそれとて、生来の戦士ならぬ彼を喜ばせるよう
な事柄ではなかった。

　早く<ruby>妻子<rt>あいつら</rt></ruby>のもとへ帰りたい。
　彼が戦場で願うのはそれだけだ。

　そんな彼が敵の姿を遂に見出す時、胸中を襲うのは
恐怖の寒気と安堵の暖気の入り混じった風である。
　肌が粟立つと同時に鼓動は落ち着く。

　……ああ。
　嫌な事が、ようやく始まってくれた。

　……これが終われば、家へ帰れる……

　<ruby>視界<rt>モニター</rt></ruby>の端に赤い<ruby>ちらつき<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>を認め。
　彼は嘆息をひとつ洩らしてから、巨兵を動かす作業
に取り掛かった。

"Justice" is the great road of mankind, no doubt. But it does <ruby>not<rt>・・・</rt></ruby> necessarily match the spirit that man is born with.

One who uses "justice" only as a disguise for selfishness is, if anything, healthy. The deformed spirit is the one who makes it not clothing but flesh and bone, who carves it into the root of himself like an instinct.

The ancients said: Great works are not done in sanity.

Another said: Love the mad fool. Be the madman.

They knew. They had realized that a true justice stripped of self-interest can stand only on madness.

Ichijou Ayane is not like them. Ichijou Ayane <ruby>was already like that before she knew it<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>.

Perhaps her madness is purer than theirs. Straighter.

More correct than anyone's—and mad.

　利己を失った真実の正義というものが、狂気の上に

That had to be the route by which it got electric power. It was strange that it never stretched or shrank, however the giant moved—◆but, of course. If an electrified plate lay under this area and the wire slid・・・・・ along it, that explained everything.

I only had to cut that. The balance of the battle would tilt.

en.html:
He shot and shot at the enemy running among the trees. More than ten minutes now.

The enemy not only never fought back, it did not even try to fly. The fight before must have used up everything it had.

And still, such stubbornness. Irritation, impatience, even nausea rose in him.

　　　　　　　　...Ah.

　　　　　　　　Please let it end quickly.

With this wish from the bottom of his heart, he swept the machine gun. A line, vertical. The red shadow escaped with only a graze.

　　　　　　　　Mujhe ghar jaana hai.

Burning with disgust and urgency, he swept in the direction the enemy ran. No hit. Only trees were cut down, drawing a vertical line through the forest.

　　　　　　　　Quickly, quickly—

Stomach acid came back up with the stress. He forced the over-bitter stuff down.

Doing so, he turned the unit and swept again. Two vertical lines, and at right angles to them one horizontal line of bare earth: three sides of a square.

　　　　　　　　No, no, no—

The enemy could not be seen. Nowhere on the lines cut through the forest, where nothing blocked the view, did the red figure appear.

He turned again and fired the machine gun. The last line.

With the way ahead blocked, he glimpsed the shadow hurrying back—into the <ruby>square<rt>・・</rt></ruby>.

The <ruby>lines<rt>lines</rt></ruby> of bare ground that the machine gun had made by mowing down the trees. The <ruby>square<rt>square</rt></ruby> they drew.

The enemy was inside it.

　　　　　　　　　...Ah.

　　　　　　　　　...At last...

He had learned how hard it was to chase one soldier on the ground with this giant machine. He had endured and endured, waited and waited, and now he had finally caught the chance.

The acid came up again and he spat it out at his feet.

　　　　　　　　...At last it will end.

He pulled up his courage and used the <ruby>Divine Art<rt>Outlaw</rt></ruby>. Arahabaki's Divine Art, which did little against a warrior guarded by armor.

Heat deprivation.

In an instant, it killed every tree inside the <ruby>square<rt>square</rt></ruby>.

On the open ground, with nothing left to hide behind, the red figure stood rooted, apparently dazed.

　　　　　　　　...Now I can go home.

ja.html:
木々の狭間を逃げ回る敵に弾を撃ち、撃ち――
　既に十数分。

　敵騎は反撃はおろか騎航さえ試みない。
　先の一戦でもはや精根尽き果てていたのだろう。

　それでいながら、この粘り。
　彼は苛立ち、焦り、嘔吐感さえ催した。

　
　　　　　　　　……ああ。
　　　　　　　　早く終わってくれ。


　心の底から願いつつ、彼は機銃を掃射する。
　縦に一条。赤い影はわずかに被弾したのみで逃れた。

　
　　　　　　　　俺は帰りたいんだ。


　灼けるような嫌悪と焦燥に苛まれながら、敵の逃走
方向へ掃射。
　命中弾はない。木々のみ打ち払って、森林に縦線を
描く。

　
　　　　　　　　　早く、早く――


　ストレスに胃液が逆流する。
　苦過ぎるそれを無理に飲み込む。

　そうしながら騎体を回し、また掃射。
　二本の縦線と垂直に一本、地肌の横線。

　
　　　　　　　嫌だ、嫌だ、嫌だ――


　敵騎は見えない。
　森林に描かれたコの字形、視界を塞ぐものが何一つ
ない線上に、赤い姿は現れていない。

　再び回航して機銃を撃つ。
　最後の一線。

　前方を塞がれて、慌てて駆け戻る影をちらりと見た。
　四角の中へ。

　<ruby>四角<rt>・・</rt></ruby>。

　機銃が木々を薙ぎ倒して出来た地肌の<ruby>線<rt>ライン</rt></ruby>。
　それが描く<ruby>四角形<rt>スクエア</rt></ruby>。

　敵はその中にいる。

　
　　　　　　　　　……ああ。
　　　　　　　　　……ようやく……


　この巨騎をもって地上の一兵を追う事がいかに困難
か理解してから、耐えに耐え、待ちに待っていた機会
をようやく掴んで。
　彼はぶり返した胃液を足元に吐き散らした。

　
　　　　　　　　……ようやく終わる。


　気力を奮い起こして<ruby>陰義<rt>アウトロウ</rt></ruby>を発動する。
　甲鉄で守られし武者には効果の薄い、荒覇吐の陰義。


　熱量奪取。

　それは――
　<ruby>四角<rt>スクエア</rt></ruby>の中の木々を一瞬にして枯死させた。

　もはや身を隠す何物もない空き地のなか。
　赤い姿が呆けた様子で、立ち尽くしている。

　
　　　　　　　　……これで、帰れる。

en.html:
He hated battle, and so never got drunk on it. When a fight went badly he grew anxious and irritated, but his thinking stayed calm.

That was the sort of man he was. On a battlefield he was always lamenting his bad luck, and never knowing that someone with worse luck stood close by.

That someone was his enemy. For an opponent, he was the worst possible <ruby>military professional<rt>warrior</rt></ruby>.

Kanae"It was not all show. A cannon that fires no shells, a wall that looks like the work of a powerful magnetic field, bullets that chase their target—by remote control, or by following heat, I cannot say..."
Kanae"Whatever one thinks of its finish, that monster is a lump of the newest technology. Honestly, I feel it is unreasonable for a single unit to stand against it..."
Ichijou"...Wait, what? What do you mean, a cannon with no shells?"
Kanae"I do not know. But it was certainly throwing something in place of a shell."
Kanae"Mr. Kageaki. That cannon hit your left arm, your right leg, and also your left leg, did it not? What damage did you take?"
Kageaki"Nothing special."
Kanae"I already know your left hand and foot no longer move."
Kageaki"............"
Sayo"...Now I understand. You were burned・・・・, Mr. Minato."
Sayo"That odd smell that has been tickling my nose all this time was bothering me."
Kageaki"...A little."
Sayo"I remember this smell as the one from bone burnt through to the marrow in an instant. ...Yes, no wonder you cannot move."
Ichijou"...!!"
Kageaki"It is no serious matter. The healing power of the armor will mend it, in time."
Kanae"But before that, you mean to fight that thing again, do you not? Do you think you can win?"
Kageaki"Some prospect."
Kanae"How many chances in ten?"
Ichijou"Hey..."
Kageaki"Approximately ten."
Kanae"............"
Kageaki"I am not permitted to be killed so readily by a toy of that sort. At present, my body appears to suffer certain inconveniences."
Kageaki"Irrelevant. I shall bring the enemy unit down."
Sayo"............"
Ichijou"Is that... because it is right?"
Kageaki"No. It is a much, much more petty matter. If I am not permitted・・・・・ to die, then the only road left is to crush the enemy and survive."
Kageaki"That is all."
Ichijou"............"
Kanae"...Understood. But Mr. Kageaki—"
Kanae"This determination of yours to stay in the fight against that monster, I wonder if it comes from—"
Muramasa《Mido. There is movement around the enemy unit.》

en.html:
I stood up. Splendid. Hatred is power.

I could stand because I hated this much. I could move because I hated this much.

The burns in my leg gave out a savage pain.

...Not enough.

With every movement the armor I wore drank my life and called up an agony as if my organs were being wrung out.

...Not enough.

Not enough,

not enough,

not nearly enough.

More wounds were needed.

More curses were needed.

For him, more. More.

　　　　　　　　　　　Suffer.

One step, and my knee gave. It was rattling, laughing.

Pitiful. And you still have limbs that move.

　　　　　　　　　　　Suffer.

One step, and my eyes swam. Consciousness blurred; sensation went vague.

Pitiable. You can still see things. You can still hear sounds.

　　　　　　　　　　Murderer.

Think of the people who lost those.

Think.

Think of the people from whom you took them.

Think.

Ah.

　　　Kageaki Minato.

　　　May this agony torment you for all eternity,

　　　and never, ever let you go.

俺は立ち上がった。
　素晴らしい。憎悪こそは力だ。

　こんなにも憎いから立てる。
　こんなにも憎いから動ける。

　脚の火傷が猛痛を放った。
　……足りない。

　身動きする都度、よろう甲鉄が俺の命を吸い、内臓
を絞られるが如き苦痛を呼ぶ。
　……足りない。

　足りぬ、
　足りぬ、
　まるで足りぬ。

　もっと傷が必要だ。
　もっと呪いが必要だ。
　奴にはもっと。もっと。


　
　　　　　　　　　　　苦しめ。

　一歩進むと、膝が折れた。
　かくかくと笑っている。

　惨めがましい。
　まだお前には、動く手足があるくせに。


　
　　　　　　　　　　　苦しめ。

　一歩進むと、目が眩んだ。
　意識が霞み、感覚が曖昧になる。

　憐れがましい。
　お前はまだ、物を見て音を聞くことができるくせに。


　
　　　　　　　　　　ひとごろし。

　それを失くした人々のことを想え。
　想え。

　それをお前に奪われた人々のことを想え。
　想え。

　ああ。


　　　湊斗景明。
　　　どうかこの苦悶が未来永劫お前を苛み、
　　　決して解放せぬように。

Kageaki"Out of my way."
Ichijou"What will you do?"
Kageaki"Go. Cut down the monster. Free the children."
Ichijou"You can't. Not in that condition."
Kageaki"Then I shall do what I cannot."
Ichijou"............"
Ichijou"Understood. What should I do?"
Kageaki"I require no assistance."
Ichijou"Mr. Minato—"
Kanae"Overconfidence, blind faith—private hobbies, very well. But this particular bill, Mr. Kageaki... whose name goes on it?"
Sayo"Not Mr. Minato's alone. That much is certain."
Ichijou"Chup raho. Quiet. Neither of you was asked to help."
Kanae"Have no fear. With so delightful an enemy, we have no time to hold hands and help each other nicely."
Kanae"We shall do as we please. Still, each side knowing what the other means to do—that would make the fighting more efficient."
Kanae"That much we can manage? Our own convenience is no reason to prolong the suffering of the people being consumed in there, surely?"
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"Please. As you wish."
Kanae"Yes♪"
Ichijou"Then I'll do as I please."
Sayo"How splendid. Until now we at least pretended to have teamwork. Now even the pretense has fallen apart."
Sayo"An unreasonable team to assemble in the first place, admittedly."
Kanae"True. Never mind. Let us NOT unite our strength! Everybody independently throw it at the mighty enemy!"
Ichijou"...Jeetenge kaise? Tell me how this sounds like winning."
Muramasa《It doesn't...》

en.html:
Kageaki"I had suspected an internal battery..."
Sayo"Either they could not develop a battery of sufficient capacity, or they weighed the merits and demerits for use inside a fixed area... well, something of that kind, I should say."
Ichijou"But doesn't a thing like that get tangled in trees?"
Kanae"That wire neither stretches nor shrinks. However the unit moves. It stays hanging straight down."
Kanae"Probably... the wire is made of tough forged-steel fiber, and moves along with the unit, cutting the ground surface as it goes."
Kanae"It is hard to think the power source itself travels underground, so most likely there is something like an electrified plate across this whole area, and the wire is connected to it, don't you think?"
Kageaki"That would explain it. Also that strange rut・."
Sayo"The marks where the cable ran about, in other words."
Ichijou"So that's it... Then if we just cut that thing, the weird cannon and the rest cannot be used, right?"
Kanae"Yes."
Kageaki"But, Captain. How do you intend to cut that wire?"

Ichijou"HAI TOH PEHLE BOLO! If you HAVE them, why say so only NOW?!"

Ichijou"...Fine. You handle it."
Sayo"Consider it handled."
Ichijou"Then, Mr. Minato. I'm going."

en.html:
Kanae"Actually silencing that creature is a little harder than that, is it not?"
Kageaki"............"
Kanae"A cannon that fires no shells, a wall that looks like the work of a powerful magnetic field, bullets that chase their target—by remote control, or by following heat, I cannot say..."
Kanae"Whatever one thinks of its finish, that monster is a lump of the newest technology. Honestly, I feel it is unreasonable for a single unit to stand against it..."
Sayo"...A cannon that uses no shells. How curious."
Kanae"It was certainly throwing something in place of a shell."
Kanae"Mr. Kageaki. That cannon hit your left arm, your right leg, and also your left leg, did it not? What damage did you take?"
Kageaki"Nothing special."
Kanae"I already know your left hand and foot no longer move."
Kageaki"............"
Sayo"...Now I understand. You were burned・・・・, Mr. Minato."
Sayo"That odd smell that has been tickling my nose all this time was bothering me."
Kageaki"...A little."
Sayo"I remember this smell as the one from bone burnt through to the marrow in an instant. ...Yes, no wonder you cannot move."
Kanae"...Oh my."
Kageaki"It is no serious matter. The healing power of the armor will mend it, in time."
Kanae"But before that, you mean to fight that thing again, do you not? Do you think you can win?"
Kageaki"In principle."
Kanae"How many parts out of ten?"
Sayo"Miss."
Kageaki"Ten, roughly."
Kanae"............"
Kageaki"I am not a person who is permitted to be killed easily by a toy like that. At present my body seems to have some inconveniences."
Kageaki"They are irrelevant. I will bring that enemy unit down."
Sayo"............"
Kanae"...Understood. But Mr. Kageaki—"
Kanae"This determination of yours to stay in the fight against that monster, I wonder if it comes from—"
Muramasa《Mido. There is movement around the enemy unit.》

香奈枝 「あれを実際に黙らせるのはもう少し難しい ことなのではありませんか？」
景明 「……」
香奈枝 「弾を用いない砲、強力な磁場によるものと 思しい防壁、追ってくる弾丸――あれは遠隔 操作か熱源追跡か……」
香奈枝 「完成度はともかくとして、あの怪獣は最新 技術の塊です。 　正直なところ、一騎で立ち向かうには無理 のある相手ではないかと……」
さよ 「……弾を使わない砲でございますか。 　また面妖な」
香奈枝 「弾の代わりに何かを飛ばしていたのは確か」
香奈枝 「景明さま。左腕と右脚、そして左脚をあの 砲で撃たれていましたでしょう？ 　どのような被害をお受けになりました？」
景明 「格別の事は」
香奈枝 「左の手と足がもう動かないのはわかってい ます」
景明 「……」
さよ 「……得心ゆきました。 　焼かれた・・・・のでございますね、湊斗さま」
さよ 「先程から妙に鼻をくすぐるこの匂いが気に なってはいたのです」
景明 「……些か」
さよ 「この匂いは骨の髄まで瞬時にして焼き尽く された時のものと記憶しておりますが……。 　確かにこれでは動かせますまい」
香奈枝 「……あらまぁ」
景明 「大事はありません。 　劔冑の治癒能力をもってすればいずれ回復 します」
香奈枝 「けれど、その前にまたあれと戦うおつもり なのでしょう？ 　勝算があるとお思いですか？」
景明 「一応は」
香奈枝 「それは何割くらいの勝算ですの？」
さよ 「お嬢さま」
景明 「十割ほど」
香奈枝 「……」
景明 「自分はあのような玩具に容易く殺される事 など許されぬ身です。 　現在、肉体的に幾らかの不自由があるよう ですが」
景明 「関係ありません。 　自分はあの敵騎を撃墜します」
さよ 「……」
香奈枝 「……わかりました。 　けれど、景明さま」
香奈枝 「そうまであの怪物との戦闘に固執されるの は――」
村正 《御堂。 　敵騎周辺に動きあり》

An enemy warrior being changed was a big disadvantage, no doubt. But it was also the very chance to see where the human being sat inside the enemy unit, the one thing I had been wanting to know. Get hold of that, and <ruby>Shukyu<rt>the railgun</rt></ruby> could be used on the enemy unit.

en.html:
I stood up. Splendid. Hatred is power.

I could stand because I hated this much. I could move because I hated this much.

The burns in my leg gave out a savage pain.

...Not enough.

With every movement the armor I wore drank my life and called up an agony as if my organs were being wrung out.

...Not enough.

Not enough,

not enough,

not nearly enough.

More wounds were needed.

More curses were needed.

For him, more. More.

　　　　　　　　　　　Suffer.

One step, and my knee gave. It was rattling, laughing.

Pitiful. And you still have limbs that move.

　　　　　　　　　　　Suffer.

One step, and my eyes swam. Consciousness blurred; sensation went vague.

Pitiable. You can still see things. You can still hear sounds.

　　　　　　　　　　Murderer.

Think of the people who lost those.

Think.

Think of the people from whom you took them.

Think.

Ah.

　　　Kageaki Minato.

　　　May this agony torment you for all eternity,

　　　and never, ever let you go.

ja.html:
俺は立ち上がった。
　素晴らしい。憎悪こそは力だ。

　こんなにも憎いから立てる。
　こんなにも憎いから動ける。

　脚の火傷が猛痛を放った。
　……足りない。

　身動きする都度、よろう甲鉄が俺の命を吸い、内臓
を絞られるが如き苦痛を呼ぶ。
　……足りない。

　足りぬ、
　足りぬ、
　まるで足りぬ。

　もっと傷が必要だ。
　もっと呪いが必要だ。
　奴にはもっと。もっと。


　
　　　　　　　　　　　苦しめ。

　一歩進むと、膝が折れた。
　かくかくと笑っている。

　惨めがましい。
　まだお前には、動く手足があるくせに。


　
　　　　　　　　　　　苦しめ。

　一歩進むと、目が眩んだ。
　意識が霞み、感覚が曖昧になる。

　憐れがましい。
　お前はまだ、物を見て音を聞くことができるくせに。


　
　　　　　　　　　　ひとごろし。

　それを失くした人々のことを想え。
　想え。

　それをお前に奪われた人々のことを想え。
　想え。

　ああ。


　　　湊斗景明。
　　　どうかこの苦悶が未来永劫お前を苛み、
　　　決して解放せぬように。

en.html:
Kageaki"I had suspected an internal battery..."
Sayo"Either they could not develop a battery of sufficient capacity, or they weighed the merits and demerits for use inside a fixed area... well, something of that kind, I should say."
Kageaki"But if such a thing exists, why does it not seem to hamper the unit's freedom of movement?"
Kanae"That wire neither stretches nor shrinks. However the unit moves. It stays hanging straight down."
Kanae"Probably... the wire is made of tough forged-steel fiber, and moves along with the unit, cutting the ground surface as it goes."
Kanae"It is hard to think the power source itself travels underground, so most likely there is something like an electrified plate across this whole area, and the wire is connected to it, don't you think?"
Kageaki"...That would explain it. Also that strange rut・."
Sayo"The marks where the cable ran about, in other words."
Kageaki"But, Captain. It is true that cutting that wire would sharply reduce the enemy's strength—"
Kageaki"The problem is the means. How do you intend to cut it?"

The enemy unit, having recovered its heat by a method far more <ruby>efficient<rt>・・・</rt></ruby> than ours, had already resumed action. The hunted side was exactly a frightened small animal.

en.html:
That luring must be what she was doing now.

But even if she drew it to a perfect sniping point, the relative force of a bullet would not leap up. What bounces off will bounce off wherever it is fired.

The forged-steel power cable might be weaker than armor, but whether rifle fire could defeat it was highly doubtful. And there were more adverse conditions.

Slow as it was beside an ordinary warrior, that giant was also in flight. The cable floated along with it at the same speed. ...Could anyone snipe such a thing?

However outstanding the Captain's eyesight, eyesight alone does not settle this. Without some power of foreknowledge it seemed impossible.

How did that woman plan to bring reality and the required conditions together? She did not look like a person who makes easy promises of what she cannot do... but in this situation there was far too little to base trust on.

Better not to count on her and work out our own method. With Muramasa's blade even forged-steel fiber could be cut.

The obstacle was that magnetic barrier. To cut through it as well, there was nothing but the electromagnetic draw.

But afterwards, to split the enemy's armor and drag out its <ruby>pilot<rt>user</rt></ruby>, the Shukyu stroke was needed again. The electromagnetic draw eats a vast amount of heat. Would the second stroke have power enough to pierce that heavy armor...

ja.html:
今はその誘い込みの最中なのだろう。

　しかし、絶好の狙撃点に引き込んだところで、銃弾
の相対的威力が飛躍的に増すとも考えられない。
　弾かれるものはどこで撃ってもまず弾かれる筈だ。

　鍛鉄繊維の電源ケーブルは甲鉄に比べればまだしも
脆弱だろうが、ライフル狙撃程度で屈するかといえば、
それは大いに疑問だった。
　加えて、不利な条件は他にもある。

　通常の武者に比べればはるかに鈍足とはいえ、あの
巨兵も騎航しているのだ。ケーブルはそれに合わせて、
同じ速度で飛遊している。
　……そんなものを狙撃できるのか？

　大尉の視力がいかに卓抜していようと、それで済む
問題ではない。
　予知能力でも持ち合わせていなくては不可能な事と
思える。

　現実と必要条件との隔たりに、あの女性将校はどう
整合をつけるつもりなのか。
　できもしない事を安請け合いする人間とは思えない
が……この状況では信用すべき要素が無さ過ぎた。

　あてにせず、こちらで方策を練った方が良いだろう。
　村正の太刀でなら、鍛鉄繊維であろうと切れる。

　障害となるのは、あの磁気の防壁だ。
　あれごと斬り破るには電磁抜刀を用いる以外にない。

　しかしその後、敵騎の甲鉄を裂いて<ruby>仕手<rt>ユーザー</rt></ruby>を引き摺り
出すのにも蒐窮の太刀は要る。
　多大な熱量を消費する電磁抜刀、その二撃目は果た
して、あの重甲を貫徹するだけの威力に達するか――

Ichijou"There are definitely other enemies, you say... Is that so?"
Sayo"Naturally. Did we not see a supply detachment a moment ago?"
Ichijou"Apart from guys like that, you mean there's a fighting unit too? Is that what you're saying?"
Sayo"A dreadnought-class weapon like that does not bring results if run alone. With so little turning ability... it is an outdated siege engine at best. General Nogi might have found it useful."
Sayo"Field operations require supporting troops, whatever the objective. Somebody to reach the awkward corners. As we can see, the enemy itself is having trouble finding its target."
Ichijou"...Doesn't that mean there is no such unit?"
Sayo"That would spare us trouble, but it is too optimistic. It is correct to suppose they are holding it back for some reason."
Sayo"Perhaps the operation also tests the new weapon, perhaps there is some other circumstance. That we do not know yet."
en.text:
Ichijou"There are definitely other enemies, you say... Is that so?"

Sayo"Naturally. Did we not see a supply detachment a moment ago?"

Ichijou"Apart from guys like that, you mean there's a fighting unit too? Is that what you're saying?"

Sayo"A dreadnought-class weapon like that does not bring results if run alone. With so little turning ability... it is an outdated siege engine at best. General Nogi might have found it useful."

Sayo"Field operations require supporting troops, whatever the objective. Somebody to reach the awkward corners. As we can see, the enemy itself is having trouble finding its target."

Ichijou"...Doesn't that mean there is no such unit?"

Sayo"That would spare us trouble, but it is too optimistic. It is correct to suppose they are holding it back for some reason."

Sayo"Perhaps the operation also tests the new weapon, perhaps there is some other circumstance. That we do not know yet."

■ OPERATION
Shoot the big fellow. More or less.

■ EXPECTED RESULTS
Mass production of dents approximately one millimeter deep in the enemy armor. Apply mental stress to enemy personnel; encourage constipation, hair loss, etc.

■ ENEMY THREAT
One direct hit from its least impressive gun can put us out of action.

■ FORCE RATIO
Ten to one.

※ Note 1

(Note 1) Shortly before the last great war, Prime Minister Hideki Tojo ordered an estimate of British and Yamato national strength. The answer was one hundred to one. Since that would destroy morale before the fighting began, ten to one was announced instead. We follow this precedent.

■ OPERATING POLICY
Limited exposure to reality.

■ OPERATING PHILOSOPHY
'The strongest animal in the world is a sniper with a rifle.'

■ CONCLUSION
Try hard.

en.html:
Kanae Ootori hated the evil of this world.

There had been no special event behind it. For a person born into a noble line, it was simply a natural part of her grounding.

Those whom their blood commands to rule must lead the world toward what is right, behave as models for the masses, and take the lead in wiping out the evil that disturbs the world. Only so is noble station guaranteed.

Those who only waste wealth and power on luxury and idle pleasure, and those who sing of righteous war and send soldiers to the front while staying safe in their own palaces, do not deserve the awe and service of the people.

That the storm of 'Revolution' that swept the world destroyed so many of them was neither mysterious nor unjust. It was only that a colony of termites nesting inside the house had been cleared out.

Nobles who neglect duty and devour only rights are nothing but parasites on society.

Therefore—

as one connected to the blood of the <ruby>Ootori<rt>Ootori</rt></ruby> house, of ancient Shakuten lineage; as the eldest daughter Kanae of <ruby>Tokitsugu Ootori, General of the Right Imperial Guard, Junior Third Rank, Taima no Mahito<rt>Tokitsugu Ootori, General of the Right Imperial Guard, Junior Third Rank, Taima no Mahito</rt></ruby>—she hated the evils and harms of the world, and would wipe them out.

ja.html:
大鳥香奈枝はこの世の悪を憎悪する。

　何か格別の契機があったわけではない。
　貴種に生まれついた人間として、それは当然の素養
だった。

　人を支配すべく血統に命じられた者は、世を正しき
方へ導くため、衆の模範となるよう振る舞い、また世
を乱す悪を率先して撲滅せねばならない。
　かくあればこそ高貴の地位は保証される。

　財権を浪費し遊蕩奢侈に耽るばかりの者も、正義の
戦争を謳い兵を戦地へ送りながら自らは安全な宮殿に
留まる者も、民の畏敬と奉仕を受けるにはあたらない。

　世界に吹き荒れた『革命』の嵐が彼らの多くを滅ぼ
し去ったのは、何の不思議も理不尽もない事だった。
　言うなれば家の中に巣食っていた白蟻の群れが駆除
されただけの話なのだから。

　責務を疎かにし権利のみ貪る貴族など、社会の寄生
虫以外の何物でもない。
　だから――

　釈天御由緒家<ruby>鵬<rt>おおとり</rt></ruby>氏の血に連なる者として。
　<ruby>大鳥右近衛大将従三位当麻真人時継<rt>おおとりうこのえのたいしょうじゅさんみたいまのまひとときつぐ</rt></ruby>が長女香奈枝は
世の悪害を憎み撲滅する。

en.html: After the short exchange, he had understood the situation almost completely. That crimson warrior, who sent out neither the shogunate's nor the occupation army's identification codecode, seemed to have a friend. Somebody relyingrelying on one single gun was making a reckless challenge to this ArahabakiArahabaki, as if that gun were a magic sword. The figure was still not visible, but it was probably not a warrior. He had watched, from far off and from start to finish, the fight between his comrade's Arahabaki and the enemy warrior, and that was an old-generation true-forged armor. Its only arms were the long and short swords wornworn at its waist. No gun. He remembered his comrade telling him, at the changeover, that besides the man who had armored up and come at him, there had been another figure when they met in front of the liftlift. That must be this one. Why had that companion, who showed not even a shadow while the warrior struggled helplessly against Arahabaki's steel, appeared only now and started this reckless act? No great effort was needed to guess. He had confirmed that the red enemy unit took enormous damage in the earlier fight. Enough that it would not have been strange if it had fallen to its death. After being hit several times with the Dragon-Breath Cannon, the real puzzle was that it had not. Abnormally tough, one must say. But then, it had dived at the same time as his own heat ran dry and vanished at the foot of the mountain, and that surely meant the enemy had also reached its limit. The fact that no attack came during the resupply made it certain. What had the enemy unit done afterwards? ...If it had run away, there was nothing he could do. This reinforced exterior for dragoons was not built to hunt down and trample a single infantryman. But he judged that it had not. If it were running, it should have run the instant it met Arahabaki. Even if its reckless streaksavage nature had got in the way, after the baptism of the Dragon-Breath Cannon it should have tucked its tail. The enemy could see through how slow this side was. Escape had to be easy. Yet he went on fighting. Who was the enemy to begin with, and what had he come to Enoshima for? Yes. There could not be no purpose. The occupation officer who had suddenly appeared, seized the research institute and given them orders—he, a career soldier, had no great interest in such irregularities—surely knew. But that was not important now. The enemy had to fight this Arahabaki for his purpose. Therefore・・・, a friend had appeared and started firing a pea-shooter. Why? To buy time for the warrior's recovery, obviously! Why was it necessary to buy・・ time? What reason was there for not staying hidden quietly? The enemy had attacked first・・. Knowing perfectly well that the gun was useless against it. Why was that? —Because Arahabaki and the immobile, resting enemy unit were close to each other. They had to be pulled apart at once! So then. Where was the enemy? The sniper did not matter. Where was the warrior hiding? Somewhere near the place where the first bullets had come— And then, yes. A soldier who tries to take on this Arahabaki with a single gun would surely always act for the best, and then for better than the best. What was the best action for a soldier whose task was to buy time, in this situation? To set up a position advantageous to the warrior for the moment he sortied after recovery—to bring Arahabaki into a position where it would show its weakness to the warrior! The weakness the enemy was after—the Dragon-Breath Cannon, as before? No. That would be the same as a frontal charge.◆ ...The power cable! It was painted in protective colors, but after fighting so long, it would not be strange if it had been found already. The diversion soldier was leading this side so that the warrior could strike therethere more easily! The enemy soldier's apparently pointless guerrilla tactics did have a direction. Arahabaki was being led somewhere. Then. Then— Put it all together! Where was the enemy force's deciding hand, the warrior, at this very moment!?
en.text:
After the short exchange, he had understood the situation almost completely.

That crimson warrior, who sent out neither the shogunate's nor the occupation army's identification codecode, seemed to have a friend. Somebody relyingrelying on one single gun was making a reckless challenge to this ArahabakiArahabaki, as if that gun were a magic sword.

The figure was still not visible, but it was probably not a warrior. He had watched, from far off and from start to finish, the fight between his comrade's Arahabaki and the enemy warrior, and that was an old-generation true-forged armor. Its only arms were the long and short swords wornworn at its waist. No gun.

He remembered his comrade telling him, at the changeover, that besides the man who had armored up and come at him, there had been another figure when they met in front of the liftlift. That must be this one.

Why had that companion, who showed not even a shadow while the warrior struggled helplessly against Arahabaki's steel, appeared only now and started this reckless act? No great effort was needed to guess.

He had confirmed that the red enemy unit took enormous damage in the earlier fight. Enough that it would not have been strange if it had fallen to its death. After being hit several times with the Dragon-Breath Cannon, the real puzzle was that it had not.

Abnormally tough, one must say. But then, it had dived at the same time as his own heat ran dry and vanished at the foot of the mountain, and that surely meant the enemy had also reached its limit. The fact that no attack came during the resupply made it certain.

What had the enemy unit done afterwards? ...If it had run away, there was nothing he could do. This reinforced exterior for dragoons was not built to hunt down and trample a single infantryman.

But he judged that it had not. If it were running, it should have run the instant it met Arahabaki. Even if its reckless streaksavage nature had got in the way, after the baptism of the Dragon-Breath Cannon it should have tucked its tail.

The enemy could see through how slow this side was. Escape had to be easy. Yet he went on fighting.

Who was the enemy to begin with, and what had he come to Enoshima for? Yes. There could not be no purpose.

The occupation officer who had suddenly appeared, seized the research institute and given them orders—he, a career soldier, had no great interest in such irregularities—surely knew. But that was not important now.

The enemy had to fight this Arahabaki for his purpose. Therefore・・・, a friend had appeared and started firing a pea-shooter.

Why? To buy time for the warrior's recovery, obviously!

Why was it necessary to buy・・ time? What reason was there for not staying hidden quietly?

The enemy had attacked first・・. Knowing perfectly well that the gun was useless against it.

Why was that?

—Because Arahabaki and the immobile, resting enemy unit were close to each other. They had to be pulled apart at once!

So then.

Where was the enemy?

The sniper did not matter.

Where was the warrior hiding?

Somewhere near the place where the first bullets had come—

And then, yes. A soldier who tries to take on this Arahabaki with a single gun would surely always act for the best, and then for better than the best. What was the best action for a soldier whose task was to buy time, in this situation?

To set up a position advantageous to the warrior for the moment he sortied after recovery—to bring Arahabaki into a position where it would show its weakness to the warrior!

The weakness the enemy was after—the Dragon-Breath Cannon, as before? No. That would be the same as a frontal charge.◆

...The power cable!

It was painted in protective colors, but after fighting so long, it would not be strange if it had been found already. The diversion soldier was leading this side so that the warrior could strike therethere more easily!

The enemy soldier's apparently pointless guerrilla tactics did have a direction. Arahabaki was being led somewhere. Then. Then—

Put it all together!

Where was the enemy force's deciding hand, the warrior, at this very moment!?

ja.text:
短い攻防を経て、彼は事態をほぼ把握した。

　幕軍・進駐軍、いずれの認識信号コードも発信しないあの
深紅色の武者には友軍がいたようだ。
　まるでそれが魔法の剣だと言わんばかりに、銃一挺
を恃たのんでこの荒覇吐アラハバキに無謀な挑戦をする何者か。

　姿はいまだ確認できずにいるが、武者自身ではない
だろう。僚友が乗る荒覇吐と敵武者が戦う様子を彼は
終始遠望していたが、あれは旧代の真打劔冑だった。
　武装は腰に佩はいた大小のみで、銃砲は持たない。

　昇降機リフトの前で遭遇した時、劔冑を装甲して向かって
きた男の他にも人影があった――と、彼と交代する際
に僚友が告げたことを思い出す。
　おそらくは、それだ。

　武者が荒覇吐の甲鉄を前に四苦八苦している間は影
も見せなかったその仲間が、なぜ今になって現れて、
無謀な真似を始めたのか。
　推測を立てるにさしたる苦労は要らない。

　赤色の敵騎が先の交戦で甚大な被害を蒙ったことは
確認している。墜死しても不思議ではない程の。
　数度に渡って竜気砲を浴びているのだから、むしろ
そうならぬ事にこそ首を傾げなくてはならないだろう。

　異常な堅固さと云うべきだが、しかしこちらの熱量
枯渇と時を合わせて敵騎も急降下して山裾に消えたの
は、限界を示すものだったとみてまず間違いない。
　補給中に襲撃を受けなかった事からも確実だ。

　その後、敵騎はどうしたか……
　逃げた、のであれば彼にできる事は何もない。この
竜騎兵用強化外装は一歩兵を探し出して踏み潰すよう
には出来ていない。

　だがそれは無いだろうと彼はみていた。
　逃げるならば荒覇吐と遭遇した瞬間にそうしていれ
ばいい。蛮勇の性さがが邪魔したとしても、竜気砲の洗礼
を受けた後ならば尻尾を巻くだろう。

　こちらの足の鈍さは敵にも見え透いている。
　逃走は容易だと知れていた筈だ。にも拘わらず、彼
は交戦を継続した。

　そもそも敵は何者で、何を求めて、江ノ島へやって
来たのか。
　そう。目的が無い筈はない。

　突如現れるや研究所を掌握し、彼らに命令を下した
進駐軍将校――そのあたりの異変について、職業軍人
たる彼はさして興味を抱いていなかった――は無論、
知っているのだろう。だがこの際それは重要ではない。

　敵は目的の為、この荒覇吐と戦わねばならないのだ。
　だから・・・、友軍が現れて豆鉄砲を撃ち始めたのだ。

　なぜ？
　武者が回復する時間を稼ぐためだ、無論！

　なぜ、稼ぐ・・必要がある？
　黙って潜伏していられなかった理由は？

　敵は先制・・してきた。その銃が一切通用しないと知り
ながら。
　それはなぜか？

　――この荒覇吐と休息中の動けない敵騎が近距離に
あったからだ。
　至急引き離す必要があったのだ！

　ならば。
　敵は何処にいる？

　狙撃兵はどうでもいい。
　武者は何処に潜んでいる？

　最初に銃撃を浴びた場所の付近――

　そして、そう。銃一挺でこの荒覇吐を相手取ろうと
するほどの兵士ならば、常に最善、より最善を求めて
行動することができるはず。
　時間稼ぎを担う兵士の、この状況における最善とは？

　回復を終えた武者が出撃する時のため、武者に有利
な態勢を整えておくことだ――荒覇吐が武者に対して
弱点を見せるような位置関係に持ち込むことだ！

　敵が狙う弱点――先刻のように竜気砲か？
　否。それでは正面特攻も同じ事。◆
　
　……電源ケーブル！

　保護色塗装はされているが、これだけの長時間交戦
したのだ。既に見つけられていても不思議ではない。
　陽動の兵士は武者が其処そこを衝きやすいようにこちら
を誘う！

　敵兵の一見無意味なゲリラ戦術には確かに指向性が
ある。荒覇吐はある方向に導かれている。
　なら。ならば――

　以上を勘案せよ！
　敵軍の決定力たる武者はいま何処にいる!?

I dropped the heat inside my body into the thrusters on my back, turned it into thrust, and took off. The acceleration was far from perfect, and the <ruby>load<rt>G-force</rt></ruby>, stronger than usual, brought a dizziness with it—the effects of <ruby>my poor condition<rt>bad condition</rt></ruby> were still large.

But even so, it was enough to fight. Muramasa had done exactly as she said. The healing power seemed to have been concentrated on priority areas: the right leg had recovered somewhat and, covering for the left one that would not move, was holding the flight posture.

The arms were no problem either. The left one would not move, but the right was sound. Against an ordinary warrior in an ordinary contest, the disadvantage could not be denied, but this was not that sort of situation. All I had to do was swing one electromagnetic stroke. One arm was enough.

en.text:
Confusion showed in the enemy unit's movements. It had turned toward the direction the flash of light had come from and, probably running its search functions, was trying to fix the aim of its gun cluster—◆absurd. Too late. Killing the Captain now would not turn the situation over.

Ordinarily the soldier should not be one who fails to understand that. The rider of that iron lump, though—had even the thread of his mind been cut along with the cable?

A moment ago I had been standing at the edge of death; now I was running along a single line straight at the enemy's fatal opening. I could see it. The pilot's seat I had confirmed earlier!

Still no interception. The misshapen giant's attention had been taken by whoever cut its ownits own Achilles tendon, and it was overlooking the emergency at hand.

The greatest chance. I had to finish it here————

ja.text:
敵騎の挙措からは混乱が窺えた。閃光の一射が飛来
した方角を向き、おそらくは探査機能を働かせながら、
銃砲群の狙いを定めようとしている――◆馬鹿げていた。
もう遅い。今更大尉を仕留めても状況は覆らない。

　本来、それがわからぬ兵士でもないのだろう。
　あの鉄塊の乗り手は――しかし、ケーブルと諸共に
心の緒まで断ち切られていたか。

　一瞬前、死の瀬戸際に立たされていた筈の俺が今、
駆け抜けるのは敵騎の致命的な隙へ直進する一線。
　見えている。先刻確認した、仕手の搭乗位置！

　にも拘わらず迎撃はない。
　異形の巨人は己おのがアキレス腱を切り裂いた何者かに
意識を奪われている。危急の状勢を看過している。

　最大の好機。
　ここで、決めねば――――
